Welcome, adventurer! This is the Reaper SMP community wiki. Explore the pages to learn about the server and its features.

♥ LIFESTEAL SYSTEM

HEARTS ARE POWER

Reaper SMP features Lifesteal-style gameplay. The exact heart rewards, heart limits, and elimination rules are decided by the server staff. Check official announcements for the current system.

⚔ PVP & COMBAT

PREPARE FOR BATTLE

PvP is one of the main features of Reaper SMP. Fight fairly, respect other players, and follow any special combat rules announced by staff.

  • No cheats or unfair exploits.
  • Respect other players.
  • Follow event-specific PvP rules.

★ CUSTOM EVENTS

EVENTS

Special challenges and activities hosted by the server staff.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

Watch official community announcements for event dates, details, and prizes.

📜 SERVER RULES

  1. Respect all players.
  2. No cheating, hacking, or unfair exploits.
  3. No harassment, hate speech, or bullying.
  4. Do not spam or disrupt the server.
  5. Follow staff instructions and event rules.

Starter rules — the owner and staff can update this list with the official rulebook.
